what: ADR 0019 v5 AD-2b: user constraints classified STRONG / WEAK / UNKNOWN; WEAK violations reach scoring with a bounded penalty and are routed to the 'outside your criteria' lane instead of being rejected
why: in the owner's real-v2 labels 5 of 7 relevant tuning offers (age x3, title x2) and 3 of 4 relevant held-out offers were rejected by weak checks; this file fixes the test before any real-v3 held-out label is read for it
baseline: the same code with filters.weak_evidence_mode = reject for every check (today's behaviour), the same profile copy, the same dataset

candidate.salary: excluded: stays reject until the matches_salary correction (decisions v5 AD-2b prerequisite) has landed; it is not part of this test
candidate.penalty_applied: to the deterministic composite, before the ADR 0003 gates
candidate.published_age_ramp: 0 at freshness_days, growing linearly to 0.10 at 3 x freshness_days, 0.10 beyond

lanes.main: no weak flag and final score >= 60 (the relevant tier)
lanes.outside_your_criteria: weak-flagged, final score >= 60 and domain_relevance >= 0.7; at most 10 per run, best first
lanes.below_threshold: everything else accepted: stored and journaled, not shown

criteria.1: relevant offers (accept labels) reaching main or outside_your_criteria: at least 2 x the baseline count
criteria.2: main-list precision (accept labels shown in main / labelled shown in main) not lower than the baseline beyond the paired-bootstrap 95 % CI
criteria.3: outside_your_criteria holds at most 10 offers in 100 % of runs
criteria.4: synthetic self-check: 0 new acceptances of a STRONG violation, 0 changes to strong rejections, the ADR 0004 safety cases unchanged
criteria.5: pipeline runtime increase at most 25 % on a replay of a copy of the owner's database

decision: the candidate passes only if criteria 1-5 all hold on the decisive data; passing makes it eligible for a human promotion decision (ADR 0011), never an automatic switch

data.decisive: real-v3 held-out part (README rules 1-3 with real-v3, the profile whose sha256 2026-11-03-real-v3-dataset.json records)
data.exploratory: real-v2 tuning part (baseline 2 of 7 relevant reach the list); real-v2 held-out is NOT usable for this test because its labels motivated it
data.not_data: real-v1, synthetic tuning sets other than for criterion 4

when_to_run: the real-v3 held-out measurement runs once, after the owner reports real-v3 labelling finished; nothing on the real-v3 held-out part is computed for this test before that
evidence_threshold: README rule 6: below 30 accept labels in the real-v3 held-out cohort the result is exploratory and is not adopted
report: both outcomes are reported; any other value set measured on the real-v3 held-out part needs a new dated, hashed file here first
pooling: none: real-v2 and real-v3 are reported separately
